programme.title: Newsday

programme.title: BBC World News America
programme.desc: News presenter Katty Kay keeps you up to date with all the latest breaking news from America and the rest of the world on BBC World News America. This world renowned news and current affairs program has been recognised for its exceptional reporting at the Emmy Awards. BBC World News America won two Emmy awards for its coverage of the conflicts in Syria and the Central African Republic. You can catch up with this award winning broadcast team as they air multiple times a day throughout the week.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: In-depth news and current affairs review of the main political and economic stories of the day, featuring robust interviews with senior government and opposition figures, business and union leaders, and analytical reports that delve behind the headlines. Regular presenters cross-examine studio guests on details of policies, priorities, actions and inactions, on a range of domestic UK and international topics. There are weekly features on the arts, sports and the world of technology, and editors are not afraid to venture into niche, specialist and exotic areas from space travel to animal psychology. If the BBC's flagship Radio 4 Today programme sets the early morning news agenda for the day, then its late-night TV equivalent often gives the people in power some sleepless nights.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

Living with three young Marsupilamis is an endless source of adventures. Jade and Mica love having having fun with them, but know, it's essential to keep their existence hidden from the outside world to keep them safe. Every day brings new challenges - taking the Marsupilamis to the park can quickly turn into a frantic race through the sewers and a confrontation with a wild jaguar, or a game of golf can result in capture by Stan the zoologist! Jade and Mica learn just as much from these fun furry creatures as the Marsupilamis learn from them - they make a great team and family!

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

When her wish comes true and Lay Lay is magically brought to life, the two friends learn that when they are together, they can accomplish anything.

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover
programme.desc: New adventures for The Thundermans unfold after Phoebe and Max are sent undercover to handle a new threat in the seaside town of Secret Shores, and bring Chloe along to develop her superhero talent. While they investigate suspicious activity coming from the local school, Chloe forms a bond with two classmates, who don't realize their new friend has secret powers. As the danger increases, the Thunderman trio must stay in town indefinitely, leaving the squabbling twins in charge of raising their younger sister.

programme.title: Henry Danger
programme.desc: Henry Danger is a story about adventures of a 13-year-old Henry Hart who is lucky to become a helpmate of a super hero Captain Man. This is a real dream job of every teen. The newbie is getting paid for fighting against crime and helping to save the world. Brave Henry must hide his job from his family and friends and it is not that simple, but nothing can stop him from being a true crime-fighter. Henry himself wants to become a super hero one day, that is why he is constantly learning from Captain Man and is not scared of any hardships on the way to his dream.

While producing a webshow Carly is not looking for fame or fortune. Ideally she wants to be a role model for children and teenagers. iCarly ultimately features everything from comedy sketches and talent contests to interviews, recipes, and problem-solving.

While Tori is a great singer, dancer and actress, she doesn't realise it. Gradually she finds out that she is a true entertainer and very talented.

programme.title: Sam & Cat
programme.desc: Prepare to meet the strangest match made in bestie heaven -- Sam & Cat! Sam's loud, independent, and tough as nails, while Cat is sweet as pie and super flighty. But that doesn't stop this unlikely pair from becoming best buds and roomies! Together, they're a power duo with a love for fun and adventure -- it's just too bad that it doesn't come cheap. A booming out-of-home babysitting business quickly becomes the answer to their empty-pocket problems, but also an extra reason for countless wacky adventures to come!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When Leonardo finds himself the accidental hero in a subway station, saving the lives of innocent bystanders, he's thrilled by the title of HERO. This pushes him to a life of crime-fighting vigilantism, starting with putting the Purple Dragons in their place. But when he's caught on camera and his brothers and April see this Turtle-shaped hero on the news, they interrogate him: what's he up to... and can they get in on it? Now, the four Night Ninjas and April suit up and set out to rid the streets of crime in a single night. Now what's left to do? April finds a dog-napping ring that's been snatching up purebreds. Baiting the dog-nappers with a fancy pooch, the Turtles track the criminals and meet the villainous French florist known as... La Fleur! She and her band of hench-florists are using the dog-napping as a cover-up for a much larger crime. And when the Night Ninjas show up to stop her, it may be too late for Leo and his brothers as the whole thing goes up in flames... literally.

programme.title: Leek ja monstermasinad
programme.desc: Leek ja monstermasinad on arvutiga animeeritud interaktiivne sari, mille peaosas on Leek, maailma kõige imelisem Monstermasin, tema juht kaheksa-aastane poiss nimega AJ ning nende seiklused Veosilla linnas. Veosilla linnas ei sära ükski täht eredamalt kui Leek. Ta on võidusõidurajal tšempion ning tänavatel kangelane. Kus on pahandust, seal pöördutakse tema poole, sest kõik teavad, et Leek suudab teha asju, mida teised autod ei suuda. Ta on kiireim monstermasin terves linnas: tal on Leegikiirus. Leek suudab seljatada kõik raskused kasutades oma teaduslikke teadmisi. Kui olukord kipub kitsaks, siis suudab ta muunduda ükskõik missuguseks masinaks ning leida lahenduse parasjagu käesolevale probleemile.

programme.title: Käpapatrull
programme.desc: Käpa-Patrull on eelkooliealiste sari, peaosas grupp kangelaslikke kutsikaid: Chase, Marshall, Rocky, Zuma, Rubble ja Skye, keda juhib 10-aastane tehnikataibuga poiss Ryder. Olles unikaalne segu probleemide lahendamise oskustest, ägedatest sõidukitest ja armsast rohkest kutsahuumorist, teeb Käpa-Patrull koostööd ülitähtsatel päästeoperatsioonidel, et kaitsta Seiklustelahe kogukonda. Tuletõrjekoer Marshallist politseikoer Chase'ini, ja Skye'ni, kes lendab kõrgelt oma helikopteriga, näitavad nad tiimitöö ja hea kodakondsuse tähtsust. Neil kõigil on seljas omaenda eriline Kutsakott, mis aitab neil kõigega toime tulla - kassipoegade aitamisest rongi päästmiseni kalju äärelt! Ja pole vahet kui suur on seiklus, Käpa-Patrullil on alati aega mänguks, naeruks ja üheks kõrvasügamiseks Ryderilt. Lõbus Käpa-Patrulli fakt: Ryder päästis kõik need kutsad ja õpetas neile nende Käpa-Patrulli oskused.

Veosilla linnas ei sära ükski täht eredamalt kui Leek. Ta on võidusõidurajal tšempion ning tänavatel kangelane. Kus on pahandust, seal pöördutakse tema poole, sest kõik teavad, et Leek suudab teha asju, mida teised autod ei suuda. Ta on kiireim monstermasin terves linnas: tal on Leegikiirus. Leek suudab seljatada kõik raskused kasutades oma teaduslikke teadmisi. Kui olukord kipub kitsaks, siis suudab ta muunduda ükskõik missuguseks masinaks ning leida lahenduse parasjagu käesolevale probleemile.

programme.desc: Käpa-Patrull on eelkooliealiste sari, peaosas grupp kangelaslikke kutsikaid: Chase, Marshall, Rocky, Zuma, Rubble ja Skye, keda juhib 10-aastane tehnikataibuga poiss Ryder. Olles unikaalne segu probleemide lahendamise oskustest, ägedatest sõidukitest ja armsast rohkest kutsahuumorist, teeb Käpa-Patrull koostööd ülitähtsatel päästeoperatsioonidel, et kaitsta Seiklustelahe kogukonda. Tuletõrjekoer Marshallist politseikoer Chase'ini, ja Skye'ni, kes lendab kõrgelt oma helikopteriga, näitavad nad tiimitöö ja hea kodakondsuse tähtsust. Neil kõigil on seljas omaenda eriline Kutsakott, mis aitab neil kõigega toime tulla - kassipoegade aitamisest rongi päästmiseni kalju äärelt! Ja pole vahet kui suur on seiklus, Käpa-Patrullil on alati aega mänguks, naeruks ja üheks kõrvasügamiseks Ryderilt. Lõbus Käpa-Patrulli fakt: Ryder päästis kõik need kutsad ja õpetas neile nende Käpa-Patrulli oskused.

programme.title: Нью-Йорк New York
programme.desc: Воскресный видеожурнал о городе большого яблока и его обитателях. Что надо увидеть, узнать, съесть, надеть и... понять о Нью-Йорке. Ведущие Елена Мещерякова и Евгений Маслов покажут вам места, ставшие символами города, и объяснят, почему они до сих пор сохраняют свою важность. Мы прогуляемся по Центральному парку и Таймс-сквер, зайдем на Центральный вокзал и поднимемся на Эмпайр-стейт-билдинг. Вы познакомитесь с личными историями ньюйоркцев, которым есть что рассказать. А еще вам будет интересно узнать о странных нью-йоркских привычках, будь то плавание в ледяной воде или игра на бочках.

programme.title: Удивительное рядом
programme.desc: На заброшенной строительной площадке в Копенгагене, где уже давно царствует природа, 47 детей обретают свободу действий. Здесь они в течение десяти недель будут ходить в школу и узнавать, чему их может научить природа. "Удивительное рядом".

programme.title: Спецрепортаж
programme.desc: С 2014 года Россия систематически вывозит детей из Украины. Официально это называется эвакуацией и оздоровлением. Сколько детей находится в России не знает никто. Единого международного механизма их возвращения не существует. В специальном репортаже ко Дню детей - жертв вооруженной агрессии - три женщины, которые занимаются этой темой каждый день: юристка Катерина Рашевская, правозащитница Александра Матвийчук и гуманитарный активист Мариам Ламберт рассказали "Настоящему времени" о том, что происходит с украинскими детьми и почему это не только украинская проблема.

programme.title: Главные фигуры
programme.desc: Александр Бастрыкин — человек с лупой, непризнанный поэт и верховный управляющий безотказной машины по производству уголовных дел против несогласных как с путинской властью в целом, так и с войной против Украины, в частности. Как бывший староста Путина в университете стал руководителем одного из главных репрессивных органов России — Следственного комитета? При чем здесь тамбовско-малышевская ОПГ? И что это за закрытая зона есть в главном здании СК под неформальным названием \"подводная лодка\"?

programme.title: Балтия
programme.desc: Еженедельная информационная программа "Балтия" – непредвзятый взгляд на происходящее в Эстонии, Латвии и Литве. События, явления и люди в репортажах корреспондентов Настоящего Времени, работающих в регионе. Точная и беспристрастная информация, все точки зрения о происходящем в каждой из трех стран, входящих в Евросоюз и военный блок НАТО.

programme.title: Крым.Реалии
programme.desc: Программа о событиях в Крыму.

programme.title: Сделано в Германии
programme.desc: Программа о бизнесе с человеческим лицом. Захватывающие экономические репортажи из сердца Европы. К примеру, авторы рассказывают о рисках и преимуществах цифровых технологий в быстро меняющемся мире, а также об их влиянии на то, как мы работаем, что мы зарабатываем и как мы живем. Топ-менеджеры, креативные бизнесмены и молодые специалисты, новые тренды и традиции немецкого бизнеса - все это Made in Germany.

programme.title: Другая школа
programme.desc: И доказывает, что среднее образование — это не обязательно скука и зубрежка. Инклюзивная школа в Эстонии, датская школа Epos с ролевыми играми, школа без расписания в Израиле — здесь дети учатся не только считать и писать, но и принимать друг друга, несмотря на все различия.

programme.title: Удивительное рядом
programme.desc: На заброшенной строительной площадке в Копенгагене, где уже давно царствует природа, 47 детей обретают свободу действий. Здесь они в течение десяти недель будут ходить в школу и узнавать, чему их может научить природа. "Удивительное рядом".

programme.title: Утро
programme.desc: Программа "Утро" каждый будний день открывает информационную линейку телеканала "Настоящее Время". "Утро" выходит в прямом эфире из киевской студии и рассказывает зрителям о том, что им надо знать в самом начале дня. Главные новости, основные события наступающего дня, самые важные темы для обсуждения - в утренних эфирах каждый день.

programme.desc: Программа о событиях в Крыму.

programme.title: Сделано в Германии
programme.desc: Программа о бизнесе с человеческим лицом. Захватывающие экономические репортажи из сердца Европы. К примеру, авторы рассказывают о рисках и преимуществах цифровых технологий в быстро меняющемся мире, а также об их влиянии на то, как мы работаем, что мы зарабатываем и как мы живем. Топ-менеджеры, креативные бизнесмены и молодые специалисты, новые тренды и традиции немецкого бизнеса - все это Made in Germany.

programme.title: Другая школа
programme.desc: И доказывает, что среднее образование — это не обязательно скука и зубрежка. Инклюзивная школа в Эстонии, датская школа Epos с ролевыми играми, школа без расписания в Израиле — здесь дети учатся не только считать и писать, но и принимать друг друга, несмотря на все различия.

programme.title: Удивительное рядом
programme.desc: На заброшенной строительной площадке в Копенгагене, где уже давно царствует природа, 47 детей обретают свободу действий. Здесь они в течение десяти недель будут ходить в школу и узнавать, чему их может научить природа. "Удивительное рядом".

programme.title: Археология
programme.desc: Диалоги о вечных вопросах российской жизни и болевых точках повседневности, о войне и мире. Эти темы Сергей Медведев и его гости обсуждают в программе \"Археология\".

programme.title: Ждём в гости
programme.desc: В Грузии есть знаменитый детский курорт Уреки с лечебными магнитными песками. Летом он превращается в самый настоящий детский городок. Песок местного пляжа действительно творит чудеса, и малыши с проблемами опорно-двигательного аппарата за летний сезон начинают идти на поправку. Такими же свойствами песок обладает и в селах Магнетити и Шекветили. За последние годы Шекветили стал любимым местом отдыха многих гостей Грузии. Этому способствует современная инфраструктура курортной зоны, большие и современные отели, зеленый хвойный лес. В Шекветили на 60 гектаров раскинулся грандиозный дендропарк с редкой флорой и фауной. Дендропарк поражает уникальной коллекцией деревьев-гигантов и растений, которые свозили в Грузию с пяти континентов. В искусственно созданной среде живут 57 видов экзотических птиц и животных. А гурманов порадуют блюда местной рыбной кухни.

programme.title: Специальная военная чеченская
programme.desc: Именно в те дни стало ясно: блицкриг, затеянный Москвой, превратился в затяжную войну. Первую чеченскую. Первую из больших войн, которые вела современная Россия. Внешние сходства между той \"спецоперацией\" и нынешней очевидны любому. Но что это: совпадения или закономерности? Можно ли утверждать, будто сегодняшние Россия и война в Украине — корнями из войны той, чеченской? И почему попытка силой изменить крохотную республику изменила в итоге нас самих, россиян?

programme.title: Азия 360
programme.desc: И стратегический объект, и точка экстремального туризма, и почти забытое место. Так можно сказать о восточной окраине Кыргызстана, в высокогорном поселке Энильчек и дороге к нему. Бывший городок союзного значения, где велась добыча цветных металлов, превратился в поселение с руинами и ветхими постройками. Его стали называть городом-призраком. Но немногочисленные жители не обижаются — выживают как могут, в том числе за счёт интереса туристов к этому месту. Единственную дорогу, которая ведёт в посёлок, нельзя оставить без присмотра ни на день. Ей постоянно угрожают снежные заносы, лавины и оползни. За трассой следят дорожные службы: они расчищают путь при необходимости, дают приют людям, которые не могут проехать. При этом во время вахты они и сами оказываются без связи с миром воздуха.

programme.title: Нью-Йорк New York
programme.desc: Воскресный видеожурнал о городе большого яблока и его обитателях. Что надо увидеть, узнать, съесть, надеть и... понять о Нью-Йорке. Ведущие Елена Мещерякова и Евгений Маслов покажут вам места, ставшие символами города, и объяснят, почему они до сих пор сохраняют свою важность. Мы прогуляемся по Центральному парку и Таймс-сквер, зайдем на Центральный вокзал и поднимемся на Эмпайр-стейт-билдинг. Вы познакомитесь с личными историями ньюйоркцев, которым есть что рассказать. А еще вам будет интересно узнать о странных нью-йоркских привычках, будь то плавание в ледяной воде или игра на бочках.

programme.title: Stealing Beauty
programme.desc: Lucy Harmon, a nineteen-year-old American, is the daughter of well-known (now deceased) poet and model, Sara Harmon. The film opens as Lucy arrives for a vacation at the Tuscany villa of Sara's old friends, Ian and Diana Grayson (played by Donal McCann and Cusack, respectively). Other guests include a prominent New York art gallery owner, an Italian advice columnist and an English writer, Alex Parrish (Irons), who is dying of an unspecified disease. Lucy goes for a swim, and finds that Diana's daughter from a previous marriage, Miranda Fox (Weisz), is also there with her boyfriend, entertainment lawyer Richard Reed (D. W. Moffett). Miranda's brother, Christopher (Fiennes), is supposed to be there, but he is off on a road trip with the Italian son of a neighboring villa, Niccoló Donati (Roberto Zibetti). Lucy was particularly hoping to see Niccoló, whom she had met on a previous visit to the villa, four years earlier, and who was the first boy she'd ever kissed. Lucy and Niccoló had briefly exchanged letters after this first visit. One letter in particular Lucy had admired so much she memorized it.

programme.title: Midnight Silence
programme.desc: A serial killer ruthlessly hunts a deaf woman through the streets of South Korea after she witnesses a brutal crime.

programme.title: That's What I Am
programme.desc: A coming-of-age story set in 1965 that follows 12-year-old Andy Nichol (Chase Ellison), a bright student who, like most kids his age, will do anything to avoid conflict for fear of suffering overwhelming ridicule and punishment from his junior high school peers. Everyone's favorite teacher, Mr. Simon (Ed Harris), pairs Andy with the school's biggest outcast and social pariah, Stanley, aka "Big G" (Alexander Walters), on a critical term project. Sporting thick orange hair, a head too big for his body and ears too big for his head, "Big G" has been the object of ridicule since grade school. Before long, Andy will learn that there was truly a method behind Mr. Simon's madness as to why he teamed these two up. As the story unfolds, Mr. Simon finds himself the target of a malicious rumor after Principal Kelner (Amy Madigan) suspends a school bully for brutally beating up a female classmate whom he thinks has "cooties."

programme.title: The Little Witch
programme.desc: The little witch is only 127-years-old, so just a youngster to the big witches. Despite being forbidden, she celebrates the Dance of the Witches on the Brocken Mountain on Walpurgis Night. As punishment, she has one year to learn the big book of spells by heart, and then her fate will be decided. Determined to be the best witch she can, she gets down to work, supported by her talking raven, Abraxas. At first reluctantly and then increasingly, she discovers helping people instead of annoying them with pranks makes her feel good. But the big witches, especially the scary weather witch Rumpumpel, are suspicious. For them, the last thing about being a really good witch is good deeds. And this puts the little witch in a terrible dilemma when it comes to her final test.

programme.title: Love Me No More
programme.desc: Antoine Méliot is around 40 years old and has everything he needs to be happy: a beautiful wife, two adorable children, friends he can count on, a pretty house in the Yvelines and money. But one day he decides to ruin everything in one weekend.

programme.title: The Princess of Montpensier
programme.desc: France, 1562. Against a background of the savage Catholic/Protestant wars, Marie de Mézières (Mélanie Thierry), a beautiful young aristocrat, and the rakish Henri de Guise (Gaspard Ulliel) fall in love, but Marie's father has promised her hand in marriage to the Prince of Montpensier (Grégoire Leprince-Ringuet). When he is called away to battle, her husband leaves her in the care of Count Chabannes (Lambert Wilson), an aging nobleman with a disdain for warfare. As he experiences his own forbidden desire for Marie, Chabannes must also protect her from the dangerously corrupt court dominated by Catherine de Medici.

programme.title: The Decoy Bride
programme.desc: Famous actress Lara Tyler can't get married to author James Arber without intrusive paparazzi crashing the ceremony. Because of James's best-seller, Lara's agent, Steve, checks out the little known Hegg Island in Scotland as the site for their next attempted wedding. Unfortunately, James is a hack, and his book (supposedly based on Hegg) relays little of it accurately. Katie, an island native and the only unmarried woman on it, has been unlucky in love. She's working on writing her own guide to Hegg Island when Steve and crew arrive, eventually hiring her as a reluctant decoy bride to distract the paparazzi. In a mix-up, she and James end up married to each other while Lara, having spotted the press, goes into hiding. Katie and James now have to get an island divorce while avoiding the press while other parties seek out Lara (who has disguised herself as one of the elderly islanders).

programme.title: Summer Hours
programme.desc: Two brothers and a sister witness the disappearance of their childhood memories when they must relinquish the family belongings to ensure their deceased mother's succession.

programme.title: Granny Nanny
programme.desc: A group of pensioners want to escape the boredom of their everyday life.

programme.title: Louise Violet
programme.desc: France. End of the 19th century. Louise Violet, a Parisian teacher, is sent on a mission to the French countryside. She has to impose the free, compulsory and secular school of the Republic.

programme.title: Lucky Break
programme.desc: Director Peter Cattaneo followed up his success in The Full Monty with this prison-based comedy drama. James Nesbitt plays Jimmy Hands, an inept robber determined to escape prison under the cover of governor Graham Mortimer's (Christopher Plummer) self-penned musical about Nelson (which Stephen Fry wrote especially for the film). Even within the prison walls, there's a chance for romance with visiting psychiatrist Annabel Sweep (Olivia Williams). But can Jimmy, together with Roger, Rudy and Cliff (Bill Nighy, Lennie James and Timothy Spall), join her on the outside?

programme.title: Claire in Motion
programme.desc: Exploring a short period of time inside one woman's life-altering crisis, the story begins three weeks after math professor Claire Hunger's husband has mysteriously disappeared, the police have ended their investigation and her son is beginning to grieve. The only person who hasn't given up is Claire. Soon she discovers his troubling secrets, including an alluring yet manipulative graduate student with whom he had formed a close bond. As she digs deeper, Claire begins to lose her grip on how well she truly knew her husband and questions her own identity in the process. CLAIRE IN MOTION twists the missing person thriller into an emotional take on uncertainty and loss.

programme.title: Escobar: Paradise Lost
programme.desc: Nick Brady and his girlfriend Maria, Pablo Escobar's niece, are making hurried plans to leave Colombia with Nick's brother, Dylan, when Escobar summons Nick to a meeting. He tells the gathered men, many of whom are his family, that he intends to surrender himself to the authorities and that they will have to take action in his absence to protect his fortune. Most of the men agree immediately. Nick is visibly hesitant but agrees when Pablo asks him directly for his help.

programme.title: A Bunch of Amateurs
programme.desc: A washed-up Hollywood star is flown to England to play the title role in ''King Lear'' at "Stratford" believing he will be appearing onstage at the legendary Royal Shakespeare Theatre in Stratford-upon-Avon, the birthplace of William Shakespeare. Instead he finds he has signed on with the "Stratford Players" in the Suffolk village of Stratford St John. He goes to the United Kingdom with his career deteriorating and having problems with his daughter who is an aspiring actress on the fringes of the Broadway theatre. The local villagers are somewhat of a motley crew and are naturally delighted to have such an - albeit unsuccessful - star playing with them. Reynolds plays a typically selfish American with no time for manners, and displays an appalling lack of class, considering himself too big for this lowly setting. The transition to humble actor, happy to play with the British actors takes some time, but eventually he is reconciled with his estranged daughter and realises that he is no better, in terms of talent and intelligence, than his amateur colleagues.

programme.title: Don't Come Knocking
programme.desc: Shepard stars as Howard Spence, an aging, hard-living Western (genre) star, who, disgusted with his life & washed up, flees by horse from the set of his latest western filming in the desert outside Moab, Utah, Utah. He hits the road looking for refuge in his past, traveling to his hometown of Elko, Nevada, Nevada to visit his mother, who he hasn't seen in 30 years. And, eventually, to Butte, Montana, Montana, looking for a woman (Jessica Lange) he left behind twenty years before when he was filming a movie there. Also converging on Butte is a young woman named Sky (Sarah Polley), returning her late mother's ashes to her hometown and conducting a search of her own.

programme.title: Jeremy Wade's Dark Waters
programme.desc: Join biologist and angling expert Jeremy Wade as he travels the world peering through our darkest, murky waters, investigating tales of mythical monsters, mutated beasts and depleting fish populations. The star of River Monsters is back to explain the unexplainable, as he investigates these reported sightings of unknown creatures. Whether it's Lake Garda's reptilian monster, a species of pike the size of a man, a river monster deemed extinct in the Outback or South Africa's fabled half-man, half-fish monster, Jeremy will need to use all of his experience if he is to catch, or even glimpse, these creatures.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Animal Cops: Philadelphia follows the work of the Pennsylvania SPCA's Humane Law Enforcement team as they investigate cases of animal cruelty; rescue sick and abused animals and fight for justice on their behalf. The Pennsylvania SPCA's humane law enforcement officers cover an area of over 46,000 square miles from their headquarters in Philadelphia. The six offic ers with full police powers and six agent trainees are on call 24 hours a day seven days a week protecting the city's one and a half million pets.

programme.title: Great White Kill Zone: Guadalupe
programme.desc: 150 miles off the coast of Baja, California, Guadalupe Island is a notorious hot spot for great white sharks. Here to target the abundant seal population, great whites are silent hunters, stalking their prey and killing with a surprise attack. But the waters surrounding Guadalupe Island are crystal clear. So how do they do it? At other white shark hot spots around the world there is always a kill zone – a place where more predation events occur. But here in Guadalupe, an attack has never been witnessed. Now, a team of experts led by Dr. Yannis Papastamatiou and Melissa Marquez, are setting out to record never before seen white shark hunting behaviors. With the help of cutting-edge technology and three kinds of specialist cameras, they aim to discover the location of the Guadalupe Kill Zone.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

programme.title: Pandamonium
programme.desc: The pandas in the Wolong Panda Reserve in China have been followed by camera teams for a year. Thanks to the pioneering research performed at the reserve, 16 cubs have been born.

programme.title: Saba and the Rhino's Secret
programme.desc: Adventurous wildlife expert Saba Douglas-Hamilton goes on an extraordinary journey to reveal the true personality and secret life of the rhino.

programme.title: The Dark Side of the Sun
programme.desc: Scientists have only recently begun to understand the true nature of our 'local star', the Sun. This program discusses its past and future, and its effect on our planet.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programme.desc: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Miami
programme.desc: Animal Cops: Miami is a documentary reality series following dedicated animal control officers as they provide a valuable service to the animals of Miami-Dade County. Keeping a close eye on the region's creatures, both wild and domesticated, the control officers visit various locations to investigate reports of injured or sick animals, and deplorable cases of animal cruelty, ensuring they are provided with the welfare they deserve. The series also follows individuals from the Everglades Outpost nature rehabilitation centre, as they investigate reports of animals being improperly released into the wetland area.

programme.title: Jungle Shark
programme.desc: Dr. Craig O'Connell and Andy Casagrande travel up the Serena River to try and find out why young bull sharks swim up the river, and how they avoid the crocodiles living there.

programme.title: Wild Costa Rica
programme.desc: Explore the incredible creatures that survive in the wild lands of Costa Rica. From bizarre and unique monkey rituals to a bat that catches fish to a sloth with an unusual set of friends, journey through an extraordinary land where nature continues to surprise and delight.

programme.title: Treehouse Masters
programme.desc: Treehouse Masters is an American reality television series hosted by Pete Nelson, a treehouse builder. Pete and his team design and build all types of treehouses for clients across the country. The clients and Pete's team are the people who never stop dreaming. You'll be surprised to know how many people want to get away from the noisy comfortable cities and live in close communion with mother nature. So getting a treehouse is their chance to live a dream. Every episode will amaze you because of Pete's talent and incredible imagination. He can build any type of a treehouse, starting from a small simple ones to most complex residences with all modern communication. Every wish of a customer will be heard and fulfilled.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

programme.title: Homestead Rescue
programme.desc: This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness.

programme.title: The Last Alaskans
programme.desc: Preparations for winter are underway in Alaska's Arctic National Wildlife Refuge. In less than three weeks, the refuge will be covered in snow, making transport and hunting near impossible. Bob prepares his gear for the first hunt of the season but runs into trouble when his boat engine malfunctions. Heimo spots a gigantic bull moose - the one animal that can provide enough meat for himself and his wife throughout the entire winter. After tracking the animal to a gravel bar, Heimo deploys his signature moose call to draw it out into the open. Later, a fourth family - Tyler and Ashley Selden - arrive at their cabin to find it flooded by a rising river. After working to catch nearly 400 salmon, the young couple is forced to go on the offensive after a bear ransacks their fish pile and threatens the only means of keeping their dog team fed through winter.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People

programme.title: Gamechangers: Inventing the World
programme.desc: These pioneering gamechangers are working bring a sustainable future to our planet, transforming how we use science, technology and engineering to change societal outlooks. We follow the teams as they work across the entire world, from the deserted Australian outback to the tropical Amazon rainforests, as they design and test these advances in science. Whether it's testing the possibility of survival on Mars, ensuring potable water supplies or reducing carbon emissions, this fascinating documentary series inspires us to change the way we live.

programme.title: Intruders
programme.desc: If you thought you were safe at home, think again! Wild creatures and other pests who should be living outdoors make their way into your house on Animal Planet's new series, INTRUDERS. The series reveals real-life stories of homeowners fighting back to reclaim their homes when they've been invaded by snakes, over-run with rats, crawling with cockroaches and broken into by bears, among other invasions

programme.title: Wild Dubai
programme.desc: Wild Dubai explores the vast – often hidden – wildlife of the largest city in the United Arab Emirates, as it journeys through the traditions of camel racing and falconry, reflecting the impact of heritage on the commitment to protect the wider environment and its wildlife.

programme.title: Dogs: The Untold Story
programme.desc: Dogs: The Untold Story is an amazing documentary series providing us with unbelievable stories, research results and facts about our best friends, healers and protectors- dogs. They have evolved from predators to favourite pets, adored by millions people all over the world. They can understand people and even talk to them, they have been by human's side for more than 33.000 years. Dogs are actually more incredible than anyone has ever imagined.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri's hitting the road and digging into joints that are loading it, stuffing it and frying it. In Santa Fe, NM, a farm-to-table gem putting out hearty goodness like bison gravy fries and a lights-out lamb sandwich. In Kansas City, KS, a funky Mexican seafood spot fryin' fish and stuffin' outrageous oysters, and in El Paso, Texas, a barbecue joint serving up fully loaded baked potatoes and serious smoked sausage.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: Two talented chefs go head-to-head for the chance to Beat Bobby Flay. To get to Bobby the chefs must first face off against each other, creating a spectacular dish with a secret ingredient of Bobby's choice. Judges Alex Guarnaschelli and Jeff Mauro know Bobby's strengths and his weaknesses. Their goal: Pick the chef who has the skills to take down Bobby Flay in his own arena. The winning chef gets to challenge Bobby with his or her surprise signature dish. If Bobby goes down, the winner can tell the world, "I beat Bobby Flay!"

programme.title: Giada at Home
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis is an outstanding culinary specialist, the author of nine New York Times bestselling cookbooks, Emmy award winning television personality and the host of Giada at Home television show. Giada has quite an impressive background of culinary training from Le Cordon Bleu in Paris, which combined with her own unique Californian charm creates her one-of-a-kind recognizable style. In Giada at Home she focuses on cooking at home for friends and family for different occasions and on party planning. Holiday feast or romantic dinner, weekend vibes or average day, it does not matter- the food is always delicious.

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm
programme.desc: Molly Yeh is a cookbook author who combines her country lifestyle with her Jewish and Chinese heritage to create the most delicious new dishes. A former big city girl, Yeh is multi talented, a successful blogger and classically trained musician, its food that ultimately stole her heart. Learn lots of tricks and tips with Yeh as she cooks up her personal favourite recipes for every occasion, from family visits to brunch with the girls to a classic farm supper! This show is an absolute treat.

From spicy Chuck burgers piled high with crispy onion rings, named after her father-in-law and delivered to him out on the ranch, plus a mother-daughter collaboration of Sesame Tofu salad. Then, she makes a hearty pan of Hot Hawaiian Beef Sandwiches for the hungry kids and cowboys and, finally, Mango Chili Chicken just for her.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: The Alaska Triangle
programme.desc: Experts and eyewitnesses attempt to unlock the mystery of the Alaska Triangle, a remote area infamous for alien abductions, Bigfoot sightings, paranormal phenomena and vanishing airplanes. Throughout the series, we meet a woman whose idyllic Alaskan dream soon descends into a paranormal nightmare, as she starts to suffer attacks by an unseen force. The series also explores The Missing Douglas and whether an interdimensional portal in the Alaska Triangle led to the disappearance of the airplane carrying 44 military personnel in 1950.

programme.title: NASA's Unexplained Files
programme.desc: What do we really know about life beyond the realm of our planet? Disturbing discoveries about the rest of our universe have perplexed scientists, and the rest of the world, for as long as we can remember. Now, the files and discoveries of one of the worlds biggest independent agencies have been dug up, for thorough investigation. Each episode scrutinises questionable evidence, encounters and sightings, to shed some light on the unexplained files of NASA. Featuring testimonies of NASA insiders and scientists who have first hand experience of the enigmas, laying within our universe.

programme.desc: Supernatural documentary series that features police officers, paramedics and other first responders who share their stories of interactions with mysterious entities while on duty. The viewers will have a chance to find out what happens when events they encounter on their jobs don't seem to coincide with the laws of the natural world. Each episode investigates various cases involving ghostly hauntings, demonic possessions, alien encounters and other ''bizarre'' emergency calls told through the eyes of the first responders.

programme.title: Ghost Loop
programme.desc: Follow a team of highly specialized paranormal experts, who help both the living and the dead and focus on a distinct type of haunting - ''ghost loop'', which happens when paranormal entities terrorize the living through endless and repetitive supernatural cycles, manifesting again and again in the same location. In each episode, paranormal investigator and medium Sean Austin, empath Kris Star, researcher and tech advisor Chris Califf, design specialist Eric Vitale, and tech support Matt Lytle, examine and research their client's property and history. Then, they formulate a plan they believe will help stop the haunting - whether it's building a 1900s-era train compartment, replicating a tavern from the 1850s, or constructing a 19th century baby's nursery. The team uses emotionally charged settings to draw out the entities in hopes that it will release the energy and break the loop once and for all.

programme.title: Haunted Towns
programme.desc: The TWC team (Tennessee Wraith Chasers) travel across the US to investigate stories of hauntings and horrors, attempting to establish whether there are supernatural forces at play or if they're just folklore. The team is made up of Chris Smith, Steven McDougal, Scott Porter and Brannon Smith. Together they interview witnesses and gather evidence, uncovering the fact behind the fiction to decipher what or who is causing the hauntings. These paranormal places are scattered across America and have long claimed to have spooky pasts; the team hope they can solve the mysteries once and for all. Reality series.

programme.title: Paranormal Lockdown
programme.desc: Paranormal Lockdown brings together Nick Groff from Ghost Adventures and Katrina Weidmann from Paranormal State as they spend 72 hours completely locked down in some of the most haunted places in America. Believing that by spending time isolated within a haunted location for a longer period of time than most paranormal shows will bring them closer to communication with the spirits that may be haunting these locations.

programme.desc: Investigation Discovery and People magazine partner to re-examine some of the most high profile crime cases in recent history. The one-hour series brings viewers tales of betrayal, buried secrets and unsung heroes, ripped from the pages of one of the nation's top weekly magazines. These stories transcended news and became part of pop culture, revealing shocking twists, new evidence, and unexpected resolutions. Interlaced within every episode are exclusive interviews with People's journalists, archival footage, re-creations, and firsthand accounts by those closest to the investigations.

programme.title: Blood Runs Cold
programme.desc: This fascinating true crime documentary series follows families who, riddled with grief, have gone above and beyond to ensure the killers of their loved ones see justice. These inspiring individuals, sometimes with police officers by their side, go to unfathomable lengths to catch the wanted perpetrators, trying to find new evidence or witnesses to help crack the case and catch the killer on the loose.

programme.title: Feds
programme.desc: Agent Lewis heads up her first case and uncovers an unchecked world of sex, power and money behind jailhouse walls; a criminal gang takes control of the jail and its staff, and agent Lewis must gather enough evidence to take it down.

programme.title: Feds
programme.desc: An inside look at America's premier crime-fighting agency, the FBI, with exclusive access to active-duty FBI agents and details of high-profile and unusual cases as told by agents, informants, undercover agents and victims.

programme.title: Home Sweet Homicide
programme.desc: Home. It's the place where we feel safe, secure, loved and at peace. But not all homes are so lucky. No matter how many locks, bolts, alarms and cameras we install, if someone wants to get in, they'll find a way. This true-crime documentary series reveals murders committed inside people's homes, showing how twisted individuals invaded the private sanctuaries of American citizens to brutally slay them in their humble abode. Detectives share their experiences from working on these cases, dissecting their abnormalities and presenting the peculiar pieces of evidence that baffled them as they attempted to identify the culprit.

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: Documentary series following police officers across the USA as they put their lives on the line to enforce the law. Using real footage from the officer's body cameras, we show just how deadly routine checks can be, with law enforcement officials having to think on their feet and make split-second decisions to potentially save their, or someone else's, life. From knife-wielding maniacs to brutal shootouts, the series highlights the importance of our police departments. With interviews from the officers involved adding context to the footage, Body Cam Cops gives viewers unprecedented, exclusive access to what life is truly like in the line of duty.

programme.title: Border Control: Europe
programme.desc: In Rome, customs officers confirm a passenger is carrying drugs in sauce packets. In Frankfurt, a package appears to contain a stuffed reptile.

programme.title: Border Control: Europe
programme.desc: In Rome, a couple is sent to the hospital after smuggling drugs inside their bodies. In Frankfurt, a passenger is found carrying undeclared phones.

programme.title: Border Control: Europe
programme.desc: In Barcelona, Customs clears out a van loaded with disassembled cars. In Brussels, a passenger arrives with improperly wrapped fish and insects.

programme.title: Border Control: Europe
programme.desc: In Algeciras, Spain, a clandestine eel hatchery is dismantled. In Brussels, whitening creams containing illegal, carcinogenic ingredients are confiscated.

programme.title: I'd Kill for You
programme.desc: Tales of soured romances are explored in this true-crime documentary series, where loved ones turn against each other, leading to fatal consequences. Fraught with jealousy, betrayal, infidelity and anger, each episode focusses on a respective murder, brought to life with dramatic reconstructions and interviews with law enforcement and those with connections to the case. The series examines the incomprehensible outcomes of failing relationships, with emotionally charged partners taking the marital expression, till death do us part, far too literally.

programme.title: Southern Fried Homicide
programme.desc: Across the Deep South, heat, humidity and darn good hiding places provide a perfect backdrop for dark, despicable deeds. Southern Fried Homicide transports viewers into the steamy, Southern subculture whose lifestyles and charming drawls are captivating viewers - and covering up crimes. SOUTHERN FRIED HOMICIDE probes the juiciest stories from down in the Bible Belt, from the Carolinas to Louisiana and Tennessee. The premiere episode on June 5 at 10/9C profiles an old adage in the south: families are a bit like fudge - mostly sweet, but with a few nuts. After pedigreed Southern belle Susie Newsom's marriage fails, sweet Susie spirals and starts to have an affair...with her disturbed first cousin. When the rest of the family isn't exactly thrilled with the kissing cousins, their scandalous relationship ends with nine family members dead, spanning from Kentucky to North Carolina. SOUTHERN FRIED HOMICIDE proves that ugliness lurks behind Southern beauty when cracks in moral society give way to cold-blooded murder. Actress Shanna Forrestall, a native belle of Louisiana, serves as the gatekeeper to these salacious stories that give another meaning to things that "go south."

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: A person suddenly and unexpectedly disappears; no trace, no clues, nothing but the lingering mystery they leave behind. According to the FBI's National Crime Information Center, there are now 110,484 active missing persons cases in the U.S., 53% are juveniles under the age of 18. Most of us have heard of the high-profile cases, such as Natalee Holloway, Stacey Peterson, and Chandra Levy. But have you ever heard of Mae Catherine Rocker, Alexis Peterson or Thomas Jay Kerr? Probably not. They are just a few of the hundreds of thousands of people in this country who one day, simply Disappeared. Most missing person's stories have never been told...until now. Disappeared is an exciting series that investigates the disappearance of these victims, who are here one minute, gone the next. Each episode focuses on one victim's story, as told through the perspectives and actual voices of their closest friends and family and the investigators trying to solve the case. Through interviews with family, friends, police, and searchers, each episode recounts the actions, thoughts, circumstances and motivations that led to each person's disappearance. Experience the victim's final hours until they vanished. Watch interviews with experts, from psychologists to forensic specialists to psychics, who will offer new insights into what may have happened in each case, whether the person was a victim of foul play or a runaway. Disappeared will take you inside the world of the missing, where a person can vanish without a trace, investigators race against the clock to solve a mystery, and the victim's anguished family and friends are left to wonder what in the world could have happened.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business.

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how things that surround us every day are produced? Find out about the whole process from the beginning to the end in a documentary television series How It's Made. The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made?

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy.

And then he and his team do the restoration turning trash to gold, so that worn objects become shining gems for which Drew's customers want to pay a lot of money. All kinds of items can and will be restored, starting from a century-old suitcase to an ancient coffee machine, from a ravaged carousel horse to a large railway clock.

programme.title: Scrappers
programme.desc: Trading scrap metal is like playing the stock market. From a small collection point, scrap metal goes a long way to collect and segregate before it reaches the furnace. The steel mills order batches of appropriately selected and prepared raw materials in a specified quantity and time. To trade scrap metal, you must have the ability to do business as well as luck. This program invites you to meet people who work in scrap yards all over Poland.

This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Taking off during a major storm, a brand-new 737 falls from the sky over West Africa, and an international group of investigators soon descends on Cameroon. Submerged in mud and water, Kenya Airlines Flight 507 crashed into a mangrove swamp, killing everyone on board. And while investigators ultimately pinpoint one fatal mistake that triggered the tragedy, they also uncover a lethal cascade of issues that sent the passenger jet spiralling toward the ground.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: En route from Bogota to the tiny Caribbean island of San Andres, Aires Flight 8250 is rocked by a major tropical storm. And though the crew expects to emerge from the intense weather, they are pummeled by high winds and heavy rains on their final approach and slam into the ground just short of the runway. The pilots claim the weather is to blame, but investigators ultimately reveal the cause of the accident was in their heads.

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster
programme.desc: On 26 December, 2004, the largest earthquake in 40 years strikes deep beneath the Indian Ocean. Lasting eight minutes and stretching a record 1,600 kilometres in length, the earthquake's massive strength surpasses measurement on the Richter scale. Just after 8:15 AM, billions of tonnes of water speed towards land with a force equivalent to more than 30,000 Hiroshima bombs. Within minutes, the terrifying wall of water makes landfall, engulfing entire towns in its path. Deadly currents and dangerous debris tear buildings apart, as people across South Asia fight for survival. Ultimately claiming the lives of more than 250,000 people, it is the most devastating tsunami in recorded history and scientists are puzzled by the extraordinary size and savagery of the waves. Tsunami experts must analyze the geologic episode, looking for clues behind the tsunami's overwhelming force. Their findings re-define tsunami prediction and reveal that tsunamis may pose a greater threat than previously realized.

programme.title: Superstorm New York: What Really Happened
programme.desc: Experts investigate the cause behind the storm that ravaged New York, as well as scrutinise the US government's response plans.

programme.title: The Next Mega Tsunami
programme.desc: Ten years after one of the most deadly tsunamis ever known, scientists are making a shocking discovery. Experts used to believe that the biggest killer waves were only generated in a handful of regions.

programme.title: Real Time Disaster
programme.desc: On the 10th of May 2013, a giant wave of ice ripped through homes in the small community of Ochre Beach in Manitoba, Canada. One day later, south of the boarder at Lake Millie Lacs in the United States, another strange moving wall of ice made landfall at Izatys Resort. This rare major ice shove was caught on camera. Harnessing this incredible footage we can now get closer than ever to one of natures strangest events, explore the forces at work and reveal a unique perspective on the destructive power of ice in motion.

programme.title: Real Time Disaster
programme.desc: At 9:20am on the 15th of February 2013, in the Siberian city of Chelyabinsk something, not of this world was spotted blazing its way through the morning skies. In this episode we tell the story of the 2013 Chelyabinsk Meteorite strike through the incredible footage of the event, captured by those who actually witnessed it. Well use this remarkable amateur video to unpack the science and explore where the meteorite came from, its violent end and how it unleashed a force equivalent to thirty Hiroshima bombs on the unsuspecting Russian city.

programme.title: America's Deadliest Volcano Disaster
programme.desc: Forty years ago, on May 18, 1980, Mount St. Helens erupted violently. It was the most deadly and devastating eruption in U.S. history. Combining eyewitness accounts with rarely seen images, this show reveals the unfolding apocalypse; from the first moments of the volcanic blast, to a 12-mile high ash plume and the lethal mudflows that raged down the mountain.

programme.title: Witness: Disaster in Japan
programme.desc: On March 11, 2011, a 9.0 magnitude earthquake struck 75 miles off the eastern coast of Japan. Almost immediately, tsunami warnings blared, urging residents along Japan's coast to quickly move to higher ground. For the next several hours, residents watched in stunned horror as a series of massive waves slammed into the coast, inundating entire towns and sweeping across the countryside, laying waste to everything in its path. Throughout, amateur videographers, news crews, government agencies, tourists, and countless others were recording the sights and sounds of the unfolding catastrophe. Weaving together their footage, Witness: Japan's Disaster reconstructs the earthquake and tsunami as they happened, entirely through the eyes of those who experienced them.

programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

programme.title: Kodu keset linna
programme.desc: Seriaali keskmes on Tallinnas elav perekond - noor naine, tema keskealine mees ja nende väike poeg. Sarja intriigide käivitajaks on mehe eelmine perekond. Põnevust lisavad ka naabrid, sugulased ja tuttavad. Tegevus toimub tänapäeva Eestis ning sarjas, nii nagu ka päris elus, on armastust ja vihkamist, pettumust, leppimist, armukadedust ning huumorit. Sarja peaosatäitjateks on näitlejad Eesti erinevatest teatritest. Martin Veinmann kehastab sarjas pereisa Hannest, tema noort naist Helenit mängib Kleer Maibaum, perepea esimest naist Epp Eespäev ning pereisa tütart esimesest abielust kehastab Kadri Adamson

Kaasreisijad on pururikkad, kogu seltskonda kamandab alkohlilembene kapten. Kui merel puhkeb torm, pööratakse sotsiaalsed hierarhiad pea peale. Raha enam ei maksa, loevad ellujäämisoskused. Võimuküsimus jääb jätkuvasti. Östlundi loomingu läbivaks teemaks on heaoluühiskonna varjuküljed, mis ilmnevad siis, kui senine turvaline elukorraldus enam ei toimi.
